task.title: Connect HTTP and mail reliability sources
task.input: stats-core, real ApiDailyCounter from M3, and MailMessage/ChatNotification states
task.output: stats-reliability: HTTP and notification count adapters with explicit coverage
task.accept: 1) Produce real 2xx/5xx responses from instrumented APIs, then GET /api/admin/stats with the http source. The denominator is actual requestCount from the same scope and errors are 5xx. The coverage label names only this round's instrumented routes; no denominator gives null and an unconnected source gives not_connected. Never claim a whole-site error rate (E-64). 2) Run real notification jobs to produce queued/sending/sent/failed/unknown outcomes. Mail counts follow actual attempts/SMTP acceptance, not queuing or consultation received. If one source query fails, retain its original success time/value or report failure without a previous value; other sources still succeed (E-51, E-52, E-53, E-64, E-67).
